review_scope: Independent read-only review of the failed admission-04 validation boundary. The frozen C4 executor is asked to validate the live ledger while the live 87th row is already bound to the reviewed continuation-04 contract, so its resource-recovery tail checker rejects that row as foreign to the C4 contract. This review assesses an additive in-memory C4 historical-tail projection. No source, frozen input, resource manifest, contract, ledger, or evidence file was modified; no analyzer, build, materialization, replay, or launch was performed.

new_continuation_row.reason: This is the sealed Joern03 continuation-04 failure and is intentionally foreign to the frozen base C4 contract. It must remain an old continuation context, never be relabeled as a C4 row.

projection_design.purpose: Let the frozen C4 validator inspect exactly the historical C4 ledger it was authored to validate while the continuation validator independently retains the full live 87-row ledger and binds row 86 to its continuation-04 context.

required_sequence: Read and canonicalize the actual live ledger; verify the full 87-row SHA and sealed snapshot equality before deriving any view.
Verify the exact derived 86-row SHA, all 29 C4 tail row contract/source/plan/series identities, and the expected 27/1/1 status counts.

Invoke the frozen base C4 validation only through a tightly scoped, non-global in-memory ledger reader/overlay. It must be restored in a finally block, run under the exclusive admission lock, and never write, rename, truncate, or replace ledger-v1.jsonl.
Retain the frozen validator's complete resource-recovery packet and all its checker replays; do not synthesize or copy a prevalidated base context.

Run continuation-01 predecessor recovery against the same exact 86-row bytes, then add the live row 86 as OLD_CONTRACT_SHA with its recorded line digest, source commit, plan commit, and attempt number 3.
Use the full live rows for current _tail/_validate_tail_identity and every future Joern04/CodeQL01 row. The projected 86-row view must never be used to admit or select a future tail.

required_result.frozen_base_context: base bytes_sha256 remains 1194072f... and resource recovery retains the original 55 completions and two historical failures.
required_result.historical_contexts: The continuation context map contains the original C1/C2/C3/C4 contexts plus OLD_CONTRACT_SHA; all 82 completions and five noncompleted historical rows retain exact provenance.
required_result.future_tail: The full live ledger currently has no rows after sealed row 87; a later Joern04 row must be validated against the repaired contract SHA and a later CodeQL01 row against that same new context.

checks.evidence: The current ledger has exactly 87 canonical rows, equals sealed-ledger-prefix-87.jsonl byte-for-byte, and hashes to 57d8265e... . The row 86 continuation failure is therefore part of the immutable reviewed prefix.

The admission stop records the frozen executor failing before replay/materialization with post-prefix ledger row not registered to the exact C3 contract. The 29 rows from 57 through 85 are exact C4 rows; row 86 is the only foreign continuation row.

The exact byte prefix through row 85 is 23,784,024 bytes and hashes to ca7152afb422160b30c2f38677aa539a1463b45e3b41131848b3d9e81d4a1084, matching continuation-01's sealed 86-row identity and the prior reviewed manifests.

The current continuation code already requires row 86 to be recorder-error, OLD_CONTRACT_SHA, source 131fbe..., and plan ce3db..., then inserts it into a copied retained-failure map. The fix must make that code run only after frozen base validation succeeds and must preserve the line hash and attempt number.

Current SEALED_ROWS is 87 and _tail(rows) starts after row 86. Any implementation that validates only the projected 86 rows globally, or treats the current live 87th row as absent, would bypass the immutable-prefix and future-tail guards.

The frozen C4 resource-recovery validator must still execute its original packet validation and retained checker replay over the projected C4 view. Replacing its output with copied maps, skipping _validate_scoped_tail, or replaying only the 29 C4 rows would weaken historical evidence.

negative_acceptance_probes: Mutating any byte of the live 87-row ledger or sealed snapshot must fail before deriving the 86-row view.
Changing, deleting, reordering, or relabeling row 86 must fail full live-prefix or OLD_CONTRACT_SHA provenance checks; it must never be silently converted to the base C4 identity.
Deriving 85 rows, 87 rows, a reconstructed JSON serialization, or a view with any altered rows 57:86 must fail the exact ca7152... projection hash and per-row C4 identity checks.
Injecting a foreign row into the projected C4 view must still fail frozen _validate_scoped_tail; the projection cannot be an arbitrary filtered ledger.
Using the projected view for current _tail, future Joern04/CodeQL01 selection, or execution-admission receipt checks must fail; those checks must consume the full live rows and current manifest.
Any exception during the scoped reader override must restore the original reader and leave no ledger or evidence mutation; no admission receipt may be written on failure.

blocking_reasons: Admission-04 stopped before retained replay/materialization because the frozen base C4 validator reads the live 87-row ledger and rejects the continuation-04 row as foreign to C4.
No implementation of the bounded in-memory historical C4 projection has been reviewed or positively tested yet.

A derived historical view is admissible only if full live-ledger validation, exact 86-row derivation, frozen packet/replay validation, old continuation context recovery, and full future-tail checks remain separate and hash-bound.
